claims.text: Brimonidine 0.15% or 0.2%, one drop q15 min × 2 doses, with timolol, pilocarpine and acetazolamide
claims.quote: A suggested regimen is timolol 0.5% one drop every 30 minutes for 2 doses, pilocarpine 2 to 4% one drop every 15 minutes for 2 doses, brimonidine 0.15 or 0.2% one drop every 15 minutes for 2 doses, acetazolamide 500 mg orally initially
